t":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":6,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":20,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":21,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":88,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":89,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":129,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_wand","mentions":[{"paragraph":11,"text":"魔杖","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":13,"text":"魔杖","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":31,"text":"魔杖","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":31,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":59,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":64,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":97,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_shendianshi","mentions":[{"paragraph":49,"text":"神典石","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":50,"text":"神典石","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_monster","mentions":[{"paragraph":6,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":8,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":16,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":17,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":19,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":21,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":32,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":34,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":35,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":53,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":70,"text":"怪人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":73,"text":"怪人","occurrence":1,"name":false},{"paragraph":75,"text":"怪人们","occurrence":0,"name":false}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d1","from":2,"to":2,"text":"风信子自称已经接到报告，正在赶往绿心公园。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_park"]},{"id":"d2","from":3,"to":3,"text":"天空中划过一道天蓝轨迹，人们抬头张望；天蓝色少女心情并不美妙。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d3","from":4,"to":4,"text":"魔法少女风信子的真名是南小风。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d4","from":5,"to":5,"text":"今天是开学前第二天，南小风在家补暑假作业，英雄协会的紧急通讯打断了她补作业的期望。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_heroassociation"]},{"id":"d5","from":6,"to":6,"text":"通讯称蓉城绿心公园出现怪人袭击，要求立刻前往支援。","channel":"document","mode":"request","holder":"r_heroassociation","about":["r_park","r_rongcheng","r_monster"]},{"id":"d6","from":7,"to":7,"text":"这让南小风今天的心情非常不好。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d7","from":8,"to":8,"text":"她暗暗决定今天袭击绿心公园的怪人不会有好下场。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_park","r_monster"]},{"id":"d8","from":10,"to":10,"text":"少女落地发出啪嗒一声。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d9","from":11,"to":12,"text":"少女轻巧落地，握紧魔杖环顾四周；绿心公园原本有路灯却一片昏黑，居民已疏散，周围安静得出奇。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand","r_park"]},{"id":"d10","from":13,"to":13,"text":"南小风默默将魔杖攥紧了些。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand"]},{"id":"d11","from":14,"to":14,"text":"魔法少女风信子小声说真安静啊。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d12","from":15,"to":16,"text":"白貂般的奇妙生物回答她，提醒当心，这附近有怪人的气息。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d13","from":17,"to":17,"text":"南小风没好气地回应：自己当然知道有怪人，接到的报告就说这里出现了怪人袭击事件。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_park","r_monster"]},{"id":"d14","from":18,"to":18,"text":"天蓝色的魔法少女迈开脚步，一边警惕四周，一边朝魔力气息方向快步走去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d15","from":19,"to":19,"text":"这并不是她第一次应对怪人袭击。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d16","from":20,"to":20,"text":"半年前离家出走的南小风遇到身边这只自称白灵的观星者精灵，在他的引导下获得一枚守护之星，从此以魔法少女风信子身份活跃于蓉城。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_bailin","r_rongcheng","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d17","from":21,"to":21,"text":"这期间出现十几起英雄协会无法处理的怪人袭击，南小风屡次成功解决，风信子成为蓉城民众常谈论的话题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_heroassociation","r_rongcheng","r_monster"]},{"id":"d18","from":22,"to":22,"text":"白灵说这边，这边的气息最强烈。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin"]},{"id":"d19","from":23,"to":23,"text":"白灵飘在空中左闻右看，突然叫了一声便朝某个方向飞去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_bailin"]},{"id":"d20","from":24,"to":24,"text":"南小风急忙跟上。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d21","from":25,"to":26,"text":"南小风喊白灵慢点，并让她稍微等一下。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_bailin"]},{"id":"d22","from":27,"to":29,"text":"穿过树丛后，南小风猛然停步，被眼前景象镇住：空地游乐设施与沙坑荡然无存，只剩残垣断壁，废墟中趴着一只巨大黑色怪物并转头投来狠厉视线。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_park","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d23","from":31,"to":31,"text":"魔法少女风信子摆开战斗姿势，魔杖在手中化作大剑，警惕狼形怪物的一举一动。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d24","from":32,"to":32,"text":"白灵飞回南小风身旁小声警告：这是个很厉害的怪人，当心。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d25","from":33,"to":33,"text":"南小风没有接话，鬓侧落下一滴冷汗。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d26","from":34,"to":35,"text":"怪人形态多样；眼前这只狼形怪物散发剧烈魔力气息，这是所有怪人都有的特征；但南小风揍过的十几只怪人中没有能比得上这只黑狼。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_monster","r_heiwolf","r_wind"]},{"id":"d27","from":36,"to":36,"text":"风信子想赶紧解决掉然后回家补作业。","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d28","from":37,"to":37,"text":"魔法少女风信子没有丝毫退缩，踏前一步猛冲上前。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d29","from":39,"to":39,"text":"战况激烈。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d30","from":40,"to":41,"text":"树丛后探出毛茸茸耳朵和小脑袋，苏天晴认真打量正与黑狼怪人战作一团的天蓝色魔法少女。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_sutianqing","r_monster"]},{"id":"d31","from":42,"to":44,"text":"苏天晴评价风信子动作干练简洁、大剑每下攻击有力、五官可爱、裙子华丽蓬松，只嫌袜子短；内心吐槽哪有魔法少女穿船袜，要求穿过膝袜。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_wand"]},{"id":"d32","from":45,"to":45,"text":"风信子逐渐在战斗中占据上风，狐狐身后毛茸茸尾巴的摇动程度也逐渐加快。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d33","from":46,"to":46,"text":"狐狐心中疑惑：怎么个情况，她怎么快打赢了。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d34","from":47,"to":48,"text":"苏天晴想质问秘典：给她的强化药该不会是假的吧。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d35","from":49,"to":49,"text":"下午苏天晴研究墨丘利秘典的功能，意外发现这个不太靠谱的系统真能买东西，还准备了200神典石启动资金。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_shendianshi"]},{"id":"d36","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴斥资50神典石买下一瓶怪人强化药A，往黑狼怪人嘴里灌了进去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_shendianshi","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d37","from":51,"to":51,"text":"结果花五十神典石强化过的黑狼怪人居然被风信子全程压着打。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_shendianshi","r_monster"]},{"id":"d38","from":52,"to":52,"text":"狐狐连忙低头缩回草丛，借月光认真翻看秘典上有关强化药A的介绍。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d39","from":53,"to":53,"text":"狐狐怀疑自己搞错用法，猜测强化药是否外用不能内服，吃到肚子里反而会削弱怪人战斗力。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d40","from":54,"to":54,"text":"仔细读完最后一行，狐狐愣了一瞬，脸上重新挂起恶魔般狡黠微笑。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d41","from":55,"to":56,"text":"苏天晴心中呢喃：原来如此……等那风信子自以为打败黑狼怪人的时候……才是真正的开始啊。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d42","from":58,"to":58,"text":"风信子说这样一来就解决了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d43","from":59,"to":60,"text":"大剑劈砍，黑狼怪人脑袋结结实实吃下一剑，倒伏在地，哀嚎几声后没了动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wand","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d44","from":61,"to":61,"text":"魔法少女风信子气喘吁吁。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d45","from":62,"to":63,"text":"风信子喘着气说总算是干掉了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d46","from":64,"to":66,"text":"南小风累得上气不接下气，大剑撑住身体才勉强站立；华丽裙装已满是灰尘沙粒，几处抓痕落在裙摆上，但黑夜中难以看清。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand"]},{"id":"d47","from":67,"to":67,"text":"白灵关切地问小风没事吧。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind"]},{"id":"d48","from":68,"to":68,"text":"白灵飞到风信子身边，焦急地往她身上洒落魔力粒子，帮助她恢复体力。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_bailin","r_wind"]},{"id":"d49","from":69,"to":69,"text":"南小风说呼，我没事，就是感觉累了点。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d50","from":70,"to":70,"text":"白灵说今天的怪人实在太难缠，比他们以前见过的任何一个怪人都要强。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d51","from":71,"to":71,"text":"南小风自言自语：是啊，无论速度还是力量都很强，但总感觉怪怪的。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d52","from":72,"to":75,"text":"南小风有种奇怪的感觉：黑狼怪人确实厉害；白灵说自己的魔法少女天赋是近战压制，能在肉搏中跟自己不分上下的怪人相当少见；以往怪人多少有魔法方面的能力，眼前这只却没有。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_bailin","r_monster"]},{"id":"d52a","from":73,"to":73,"text":"白灵说南小风的魔法少女天赋是近战压制。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind"]},{"id":"d53","from":76,"to":78,"text":"突然间，清脆的鼓掌声从身后传来。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d54","from":79,"to":80,"text":"南小风强撑着转身，与月光下亭亭站立的金色身影对上视线，愣了一瞬；她看到毛茸茸尾巴耳朵、金色长发，觉得人影娇小。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d55","from":81,"to":82,"text":"南小风觉得好可爱，心想怎么会有这么可爱的女孩子。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d56","from":83,"to":83,"text":"白灵看见小狐狸胸前的金色十字星，第一个反应过来。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_bailin","r_sutianqing","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d56a","from":84,"to":84,"text":"白灵大声问：守、守护之星？你也是魔法少女？！","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_sutianqing","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d57","from":85,"to":85,"text":"苏天晴轻笑着答反应过来了吗，真是迟钝呢。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d58","from":86,"to":86,"text":"苏天晴实际上心里慌得一批，全靠提前演练才能有这么熟练的装比反派范。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d59","from":87,"to":87,"text":"苏天晴说很精彩的战斗，风信子，干得漂亮。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d60","from":88,"to":88,"text":"南小风被对方叫出代号后满脸困惑，追问你是谁，你的代号是什么，为什么蓉城会有。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing","r_rongcheng"]},{"id":"d61","from":89,"to":89,"text":"南小风想到蓉城只有自己一名魔法少女，没有观星者的帮助不可能得到守护之星，那眼前这个陌生魔法少女是怎么回事。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_rongcheng","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d62","from":90,"to":90,"text":"苏天晴回答是反派哦。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d63","from":91,"to":92,"text":"苏天晴没有给南小风从错愕中反应过来的时间，抬起双手在脸侧轻轻拍掌。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d64","from":93,"to":96,"text":"刹那间，原本倒伏在地的黑狼兽人骤然暴起，从它口中喷吐而出的并非魔炮一类魔力光束，而是无数黑影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d65","from":97,"to":97,"text":"少女只来得及惊叫一声，由魔杖化成的大剑便在暗影冲击中脱手，南小风整个人被砸得倒飞而出。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d66","from":98,"to":98,"text":"风信子惊叫这是什么东西，好恶心。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d67","from":99,"to":99,"text":"苏天晴说嗯哼，看来精心为风信子准备的小礼物终于生效了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d68","from":100,"to":100,"text":"苏天晴露出诡计得逞的坏笑，借月光观赏魔法少女风信子被复活的黑狼怪人抓住的狼狈模样。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d69","from":101,"to":101,"text":"这是那瓶强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的终极能力，能在倒下后发动。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d69a","from":102,"to":102,"text":"第二阶段，堂堂展开！","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d70","from":103,"to":104,"text":"南小风大声质问对方到底想干什么，有什么阴谋。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d71","from":105,"to":106,"text":"苏天晴悠哉走到边上，黑狼贴心将猎物从半空放下但仍未松开束缚风信子的利爪；娇俏金狐在南小风眼里俨然是小恶魔。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d72","from":107,"to":107,"text":"苏天晴问如何啊，这种感觉一定很难忘吧。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d73","from":108,"to":108,"text":"南小风质问对方到底是什么人，斥其用下流手段，要求有本事就来堂堂正正对决。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d74","from":109,"to":110,"text":"南小风几乎是嘶吼着；只有加大音量才能压制被利爪抓住的恐惧，她不愿在比自己小的陌生魔法少女面前露怯。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d75","from":111,"to":112,"text":"苏天晴说风信子全身上下都是软软的，嘴却这么硬，并凑上前用银铃般悦耳声音说出恶魔低语。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d76","from":113,"to":113,"text":"苏天晴说既然如此，风信子今晚就在这里老实待着。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d77","from":114,"to":115,"text":"风信子终于失去矜持，哀鸣着叫对方等等、别走。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d78","from":116,"to":117,"text":"狐狐停下脚步饶有兴趣地回头；天蓝的魔法少女猛然怔住，脸颊泛红。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d79","from":118,"to":118,"text":"小狐狸微笑着走到风信子面前，歪头问风信子小姐有事想跟狐狐说吗。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d80","from":119,"to":119,"text":"碧色狐眸映在风信子眼中，模样娇俏可爱，却分明藏着一股玩味笑意。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d81","from":120,"to":120,"text":"风信子说你快把我放下来。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d82","from":121,"to":122,"text":"苏天晴问风信子小姐想不想跟狐狐玩游戏，要是赢了就放她下来；若不愿意，狐狐不会让它们松开，脸上笑容更加灿烂。","channel":"speech","mode":"condition","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d83","from":123,"to":124,"text":"风信子犹豫片刻，询问是什么游戏。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d84","from":125,"to":126,"text":"苏天晴踱步走到风信子身后，月光映出她脸上坏笑，然后捏起一根狗尾巴草。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder": "text":"半年前离家出走的南小风遇到身边这只自称白灵的观星者精灵，在他的引导下获得一枚守护之星，从此以魔法少女风信子身份活跃于蓉城。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_bailin","r_rongcheng","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d17","from":21,"to":21,"text":"这期间出现十几起英雄协会无法处理的怪人袭击，南小风屡次成功解决，风信子成为蓉城民众常谈论的话题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_heroassociation","r_rongcheng","r_monster"]},{"id":"d18","from":22,"to":22,"text":"白灵说这边，这边的气息最强烈。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin"]},{"id":"d19","from":23,"to":23,"text":"白灵飘在空中左闻右看，突然叫了一声便朝某个方向飞去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_bailin"]},{"id":"d20","from":24,"to":24,"text":"南小风急忙跟上。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d21","from":25,"to":26,"text":"南小风喊白灵慢点，并让她稍微等一下。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_bailin"]},{"id":"d22","from":27,"to":29,"text":"穿过树丛后，南小风猛然停步，被眼前景象镇住：空地游乐设施与沙坑荡然无存，只剩残垣断壁，废墟中趴着一只巨大黑色怪物并转头投来狠厉视线。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_park","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d23","from":31,"to":31,"text":"魔法少女风信子摆开战斗姿势，魔杖在手中化作大剑，警惕狼形怪物的一举一动。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d24","from":32,"to":32,"text":"白灵飞回南小风身旁小声警告：这是个很厉害的怪人，当心。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d25","from":33,"to":33,"text":"南小风没有接话，鬓侧落下一滴冷汗。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d26","from":34,"to":35,"text":"怪人形态多样；眼前这只狼形怪物散发剧烈魔力气息，这是所有怪人都有的特征；但南小风揍过的十几只怪人中没有能比得上这只黑狼。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_monster","r_heiwolf","r_wind"]},{"id":"d27","from":36,"to":36,"text":"风信子想赶紧解决掉然后回家补作业。","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d28","from":37,"to":37,"text":"魔法少女风信子没有丝毫退缩，踏前一步猛冲上前。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d29","from":39,"to":39,"text":"战况激烈。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d30","from":40,"to":41,"text":"树丛后探出毛茸茸耳朵和小脑袋，苏天晴认真打量正与黑狼怪人战作一团的天蓝色魔法少女。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_sutianqing","r_monster"]},{"id":"d31","from":42,"to":44,"text":"苏天晴评价风信子动作干练简洁、大剑每下攻击有力、五官可爱、裙子华丽蓬松，只嫌袜子短；内心吐槽哪有魔法少女穿船袜，要求穿过膝袜。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_wand"]},{"id":"d32","from":45,"to":45,"text":"风信子逐渐在战斗中占据上风，狐狐身后毛茸茸尾巴的摇动程度也逐渐加快。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d33","from":46,"to":46,"text":"狐狐心中疑惑：怎么个情况，她怎么快打赢了。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d34","from":47,"to":48,"text":"苏天晴想质问秘典：给她的强化药该不会是假的吧。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d35","from":49,"to":49,"text":"下午苏天晴研究墨丘利秘典的功能，意外发现这个不太靠谱的系统真能买东西，还准备了200神典石启动资金。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_shendianshi"]},{"id":"d36","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴斥资50神典石买下一瓶怪人强化药A，往黑狼怪人嘴里灌了进去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_shendianshi","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d37","from":51,"to":51,"text":"结果花五十神典石强化过的黑狼怪人居然被风信子全程压着打。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_shendianshi","r_monster"]},{"id":"d38","from":52,"to":52,"text":"狐狐连忙低头缩回草丛，借月光认真翻看秘典上有关强化药A的介绍。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d39","from":53,"to":53,"text":"狐狐怀疑自己搞错用法，猜测强化药是否外用不能内服，吃到肚子里反而会削弱怪人战斗力。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d40","from":54,"to":54,"text":"仔细读完最后一行，狐狐愣了一瞬，脸上重新挂起恶魔般狡黠微笑。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_secretbook","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d41","from":55,"to":56,"text":"苏天晴心中呢喃：原来如此……等那风信子自以为打败黑狼怪人的时候……才是真正的开始啊。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d42","from":58,"to":58,"text":"风信子说这样一来就解决了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d43","from":59,"to":60,"text":"大剑劈砍，黑狼怪人脑袋结结实实吃下一剑，倒伏在地，哀嚎几声后没了动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wand","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d44","from":61,"to":61,"text":"魔法少女风信子气喘吁吁。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d45","from":62,"to":63,"text":"风信子喘着气说总算是干掉了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d46","from":64,"to":66,"text":"南小风累得上气不接下气，大剑撑住身体才勉强站立；华丽裙装已满是灰尘沙粒，几处抓痕落在裙摆上，但黑夜中难以看清。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand"]},{"id":"d47","from":67,"to":67,"text":"白灵关切地问小风没事吧。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_wind"]},{"id":"d48","from":68,"to":68,"text":"白灵飞到风信子身边，焦急地往她身上洒落魔力粒子，帮助她恢复体力。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_bailin","r_wind"]},{"id":"d49","from":69,"to":69,"text":"南小风说呼，我没事，就是感觉累了点。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d50","from":70,"to":70,"text":"白灵说今天的怪人实在太难缠，比他们以前见过的任何一个怪人都要强。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_bailin","about":["r_bailin","r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d51","from":71,"to":71,"text":"南小风自言自语：是啊，无论速度还是力量都很强，但总感觉怪怪的。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_heiwolf"]} nd","r_rongcheng","r_guardstar"]},{"id":"d62","from":90,"to":90,"text":"苏天晴回答是反派哦。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d63","from":91,"to":92,"text":"苏天晴没有给南小风从错愕中反应过来的时间，抬起双手在脸侧轻轻拍掌。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d64","from":93,"to":96,"text":"刹那间，原本倒伏在地的黑狼兽人骤然暴起，从它口中喷吐而出的并非魔炮一类魔力光束，而是无数黑影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d65","from":97,"to":97,"text":"少女只来得及惊叫一声，由魔杖化成的大剑便在暗影冲击中脱手，南小风整个人被砸得倒飞而出。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_wand","r_heiwolf"]},{"id":"d66","from":98,"to":98,"text":"风信子惊叫这是什么东西，好恶心。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind"]},{"id":"d67","from":99,"to":99,"text":"苏天晴说嗯哼，看来精心为风信子准备的小礼物终于生效了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]},{"id":"d68","from":100,"to":100,"text":"苏天晴露出诡计得逞的坏笑，借月光观赏魔法少女风信子被复活的黑狼怪人抓住的狼狈模样。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d69","from":101,"to":101,"text":"这是那瓶强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的终极能力，能在倒下后发动。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_sutianqing","about":["r_sutianqing","r_drugA","r_heiwolf","r_monster"]},{"id":"d69a","from":102,"to":102,"text":"第二阶段，堂堂展开！","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf","r_drugA"]},{"id":"d70","from":103,"to":104,"text":"南小风大声质问对方到底想干什么，有什么阴谋。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_wind","about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]},{"id":"d71","from":105,"to":106,"text":"苏天晴悠哉走到边上，黑狼贴心将猎物从半空放下但仍未松开束缚风信子的利爪；娇俏金狐在南小风眼里俨然是小恶魔。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf","r_wind","r_monster"]},{"id":"d72","from":107,"to":107,"text":"苏天晴问如何啊，这种感觉一定很难忘吧。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_s
